item.title: Fixing Discord Bot Command Issues: Overriding on_message
item.description:
“Fixing Discord Bot Command Issues: Overriding on_message”

When developing a Discord bot using discord.py, you might encounter a common issue where custom commands stop responding after you override the default on_message event handler. This typically occurs because the default on_message handler is responsible for processing commands, and when you replace it without explicitly including command processing, your commands become unresponsive.

The core of the problem lies in how discord.py manages message events and command execution. The library uses the on_message event to listen for incoming messages. Within this event, it checks if a message is a command and, if so, dispatches it to the appropriate command handler. When you define your own on_message function, you are essentially taking over this responsibility. If your custom on_message doesn’t include the logic to process commands, they will simply be ignored.
